overview: Jenna 1 was the first 100-home release within a six-building, 631-home collection. The park and West Boulevard frame its setting.
research.locationNote: West Boulevard, Aljada, Sharjah, between a green park and shopping/dining frontage.
research.priceNote: Arada advertises from AED 899,000; confirm current stock and selected-unit terms. Found’s AED 1.555 million reference concerns a released subset.
research.paymentNote: Developer reference: 5% booking, 30% during construction and 65% completion. A dated selected-unit contract schedule was not retrieved.
research.handoverNote: Arada’s 23 April 2026 launch targets completion of the wider Jenna collection by the end of Q1 2029. This remains a forecast.
